answer: The forge schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the jetty checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 191 effective identities must lock that capital for 27 epochs and keep it locked through every oasis audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 27 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
